metadata.title: 80s Soft Rock Portrait and Neon Script

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome male portrait paired with vibrant, hand-drawn neon pink script and a textured 80s grain.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly angled monochrome portrait of a man with feathered hair, featuring a grainy, soft-focus texture. The composition is anchored by two layers of stylized text in the bottom left corner: a thin, gray marker-style script and a larger, bold, neon pink airbrushed script with rough edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject vs. vibrant neon typography
Soft photographic grain vs. sharp, jagged lettering edges
Tight facial crop vs. generous negative space on the left
Handwritten signature style vs. bold display title
coreInvariants: Desaturated, warm-toned monochrome palette for the image
Rough-edged, marker-like stroke quality in lettering
Visible film grain or halftone-like texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face occupies the right two-thirds of the frame in a tight, intimate crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes provide the primary emotional anchor, while the pink text provides the visual weight anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the subject's gaze down to the signature and finally to the bold pink title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left side of the face, used as a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark hair and light skin; extreme saturation contrast between the monochrome photo and the neon text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Handwritten cursive and lowercase brush script
letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness mimicking hand pressure
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'e' with a wide, open loop
Lowercase 'x' formed by two distinct, crossing brush strokes
Underlining that mimics a quick marker swipe

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the subject's shoulder/chest area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A thin, gray signature-style script sits directly above a bold, neon-colored brush script for a 'personal touch' vs. 'commercial title' contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: To match the hand-drawn, energetic feel of the title.
To replicate the secondary signature text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochrome, grainy, soft-focus portrait of a man with 80s feathered hair, looking slightly off-camera, with negative space on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a hand-drawn, jagged-edged lowercase script in neon pink at the bottom left, with a thinner gray signature script and underline directly above it.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait monochrome and grainy?
Is the main title neon pink with rough edges?
Is the text placed in the bottom left quadrant?
Does the typography feel hand-drawn rather than typeset?

mustRedesign: Avoid using standard clean fonts; must use textured, hand-drawn styles
Do not use full-color photography; maintain the monochrome/sepia base

mustAchieve: Vibrant, glowing quality for the pink text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grain is consistent across the image.
Verify the pink text has a slight 'glow' or airbrushed feel.
Check that the signature script is legible but looks handwritten.
Confirm the subject's eyes are sharp despite the overall soft focus.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Grainy Portrait + Neon Marker Script + Bottom-Left Justified Typography
